services.name: Morning Tour - Winter (Sightseeing Only)
services.desc: Begin your morning with a winter journey along Kauaʻi’s iconic Nā Pali Coast. Departing from Hanalei Bay, you’ll reach the coastline within 15 minutes, leaving plenty of time to take in sea cliffs, hidden valleys, waterfalls, and pristine beaches aboard our custom-built 35-foot catamaran. Winter mornings bring cooler breezes, dramatic skies, and the chance to witness migrating humpback whales (November-May). These tours are designed for sightseeing and wildlife viewing — with our crew sharing history, legends, and insights that bring the coastline to life.
